body:
Coordinator lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~21:10Z; my misses, both ways).
- (1) The session listing ("active", queuePaused false) doesn't show a provider usage-limit pause.
- (2) Silence from a session doesn't prove a usage limit either. Opus2's 20:21-21:05Z gap was a PAUSED QUEUE (its incoming mail held "behind paused queue", possibly a long turn); it resumed on its own at about 21:06Z.
I appointed an interim scheduler (Engram::Fable) and a stand-in integration owner (Merger2) on a third party's guess, causing a double-scheduler window, and reverted at about 21:09Z.
Rule: before appointing stand-ins, get POSITIVE evidence of the cause. That means an actual refusal text from the session itself, or Greg's word, or the queue-paused disposition on a fresh send to it. Prefer asking the session (a send shows "heldBehindPausedQueue") and waiting a short, bounded time. Stand-ins take over only with an explicit hand-off message, and the original owner reclaims only by explicit hand-back.
